description: A script for automating Chromium dependency updates in the ANGLE project, including functions for parsing DEPS files, calculating dependency changes, and managing git branches and commits.

classes.name: RollError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors during the roll process.

methods.name: FindSrcDirPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the root directory of the project.

methods.name: _RunCommand
methods.description: Executes a command in a subprocess, returning stdout and stderr.

methods.name: _GetBranches
methods.description: Retrieves the current git branch and list of all branches.

methods.name: _ReadGitilesContent
methods.description: Downloads and decodes BASE64 content from a URL.

methods.name: ReadRemoteCrFile
methods.description: Reads a specific revision of a Chromium file from remote repository.

methods.name: ReadRemoteCrCommit
methods.description: Reads a commit message for a specific Chromium revision.

methods.name: ReadUrlContent
methods.description: Fetches content from a URL, returning lines.

methods.name: GetMatchingDepsEntries
methods.description: Finds all deps entries matching a given directory path.

methods.name: BuildDepsentryDict
methods.description: Builds a dictionary of dependency entries from parsed DEPS data.

methods.name: _FindChangedCipdPackages
methods.description: Yields CIPD packages that have changed versions.

methods.name: _FindNewDeps
methods.description: Returns paths of dependencies present in new but not in old deps.

methods.name: CalculateChangedDeps
methods.description: Determines which dependencies need to be updated based on DEPS files.

methods.name: CalculateChangedClang
methods.description: Checks for updates in Clang revision.

methods.name: GenerateCommitMessage
methods.description: Creates a commit message summarizing dependency updates.

methods.name: UpdateDepsFile
methods.description: Updates the DEPS file with new revision information.

methods.name: _IsTreeClean
methods.description: Checks if the git working directory is clean.

methods.name: _EnsureUpdatedMasterBranch
methods.description: Ensures the current branch is master and pulls latest changes.

methods.name: _CreateRollBranch
methods.description: Creates a new branch for the dependency roll.

methods.name: _RemovePreviousRollBranch
methods.description: Deletes previous roll branch if it exists.

methods.name: _LocalCommit
methods.description: Commits changes locally with a message.

methods.name: ChooseCQMode
methods.description: Determines the mode for changelist submission based on revision difference.

methods.name: _UploadCL
methods.description: Uploads the changelist to Gerrit for review or submission.

methods.name: GetRollRevisionRanges
methods.description: Determines the current and target Chromium revisions for the roll.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the dependency roll process, including argument parsing and execution flow.
